name: Nadia Yassine
shortBio: Moroccan Islamic political thinker and Sufi-inspired reformer advocating women’s spiritual and civic leadership, non-violent democratic participation, and critical ijtihad against authoritarianism and patriarchal jurisprudence.
centralQuestion: How can Sufi spirituality and prophetic ethical renewal ground non-violent democratic resistance and women’s egalitarian leadership within contemporary Muslim societies?

keyWorks.title: Toutes voiles dehors (Full Sails Ahead)
keyWorks.description: Articulates an endogenous Islamic political philosophy uniting Sufi moral self-critique, women’s agency, and anti-authoritarian democracy.
